The Bambino Plus is a separate-grinder machine. Its basket size and the coffee's volume determine a usable dose; 18 g is not a requirement for every coffee.

segments.source: A new owner reported that 18 g overflowed the basket before tamping. Replies described different usable doses and one Bambino owner said changing beans made the same 18 g fit. The useful lesson is to check basket fit and coffee volume; the thread's suggested gram values should not override the manual.
